finite_grid.arithmetic: exact integers, rationals, and quadratic minimal polynomials

model.endpoint_convention: branch images are open; 1/2 is the primary terminal and 1/3 the mirror terminal, never periodic points of X
model.mirror_orientation: a even, b odd is obtained by leg swap and terminates at t=1/3
model.primary_orientation: a odd, b even, t=n/m with coprime m>n of opposite parity, root t=1/2 and triple (3,4,5)

nonclaims: Finite word rows audit but do not prove the infinite symbolic theorem.

The source Artin-Mazur zeta and Gamma(2) factor statement are not target Euler factors, automorphy, or target RH claims.
No literature-priority, target local datum, root number, target divisor, functional equation, target zero match, or Hilbert--Polya operator is asserted.

theorem_contract.counts: Fix(T^n on X)=3^n-2 with exact-period and primitive counts by Mobius inversion
theorem_contract.monodromy: every periodic word has exact Mobius matrix, determinant orientation, and expanding multiplier
theorem_contract.periodic: every length-n word except pure 1 and pure 3 has one quadratic-irrational fixed point
theorem_contract.termination: primary rational states terminate at 1/2 while irrational states never terminate
theorem_contract.tree: the primary Barning matrices generate every odd-even primitive Pythagorean triple exactly once from a possibly empty word, with the empty word owning (3,4,5)
